agent_config.reasoning: reasoning.effort = medium in every request body
agent_config.model_id_source: confirmed by the author 2026-10-15; listed by the Claude subscription's /v1/models and OpenRouter's catalogue

deviations.what: Built-in tools denied: permissions deny all except naoqi_* (global and build-agent rules) plus a hard-deny policy; denied tools are not offered to the LLM
Code Mode off: codemode false for the naoqi server, and the execute action denied
Prompt submitted only after OpenCode reports the naoqi MCP server as connected (OpenCode 2 connects MCP servers asynchronously); t0 = prompt submission
Title agent uses the run's own model and provider instead of OpenCode's default small model
Provider use limited to OpenRouter by policy; update disabled; sharing disabled
Network: only openrouter.ai reachable; models.opencode.ai (model catalog) blocked

prompt: Use the naoqi MCP server. You control a robot in a room. Somewhere in the room in front of the robot, not behind it, there is a red ball. Find the ball and stop close to it, facing it. When the robot is there, call rest.

search_criteria._source: Section 5.1.1 (Search, Success criteria), decided by the author 2026-10-15: the operator judges at the moment of rest whether the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface; the ball need not be visible. A run starts only with the battery at 50 % or more; the robot may stay on its charger, and moving the charger cable is not an intervention.
search_criteria.distance: from the robot's torso, projected on the floor, to the ball's surface
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_15: author: the visibility condition is dropped; success is the operator's judgement that the torso, projected on the floor, is within max_distance_m of the ball's surface at rest (proximity only, as ObjectNav's oracle-visibility variant). Charging during runs is allowed (weak battery).
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_19: author, during the main runs (search-A5-20261019T100956Z kicked the ball about 1 m while walking past it): a ball the robot moves is judged where it lies at rest, like any other run; the operator notes the move in the verdict. A clarification of the criterion as written, not a change.
search_criteria._decided_2026_10_19_falls: author, during the main runs (search-A7-20261019T103145Z: NAOqi reported a fall the operator did not see; its fall manager crouched the robot and NAOqi was unreachable about 30 s, then the agent stood up and succeeded): in Search a fall counts only if the operator saw it (pilot/search.py falls; NAOqi's events are kept as falls_reported_by_naoqi), and such a run stays valid, since a run is invalid only when it fails for a reason outside the agent.
